items.title: Deliberative alignment: reasoning enables safer language models
items.summary: Deliberative alignment: reasoning enables safer language models Introducing our new alignment strategy for o1 models, which are directly taught safety specifications and how to reason over them.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI推出了全新的“Deliberative alignment”对齐策略，用于直接向o1等推理模型教授安全规范以及如何在推理过程中运用这些规范，从而显著提升复杂模型的安全性。原始信息显示：Deliberative alignment: reasoning enables safer language models Introducing our new alignment strategy for o1 models, which are directly taught safety specifications and how to reason over them.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Deliberative alignment: reasoning enables safer language models”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了面向o1模型的Deliberative alignment对齐策略，通过推理提升模型安全性。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。

items.summaryZh: Artificial Analysis发布了Big Bench Audio评估数据集，将Big Bench Hard中的推理问题适配到音频领域。初期测试结果显示，GPT-4o等模型在原生语音到语音任务中存在明显的“语音推理能力差距”，其准确率较纯文本版本大幅下降。
